sentences.quote: "From this moment on, Lenovo will become an AI-native company," Yang Yuanqing, chairman and CEO of Lenovo, said at the company's 2026 to 2027 fiscal year kickoff event in China on Wednesday.
sentences.text: Yang Yuanqing remains chairman and CEO, and at the April 2026 fiscal-year kickoff said Lenovo would become an "AI-native company" and march toward 100 billion dollars in annual revenue within two years.

Regional leadership changed: Tareq Alangari was named senior vice president and president of the Middle East, Turkiye and Africa business in January 2026; Sumir Bhatia became the first Asia Pacific chief commercial officer in April, as regional COO Ivan Cheung was set to retire in June; and Diego Majdalani took over as Latin America president on 12 October, succeeding Sergio Buniac, who joined Qualcomm.

sentences.text: Solutions and Services Group reached record revenue of US$2.9 billion, up 28%, at a record 24.2% operating margin.
Fiscal 2025/26 revenue was a record US$83.1 billion, up 20%, with adjusted net income up 42% to US$2 billion.

thesis_pillars.text: Lenovo Group's AI-related revenue, spanning AI devices, AI servers and AI services, grew 60% year-on-year to US$9.3 billion, or 35% of total Group revenue, in the quarter ended June 2026. Its Infrastructure Solutions Group posted record quarterly revenue of US$8.5 billion, up 98%, swinging to US$777 million operating profit from a prior-year loss for a 9.1% margin, with an AI-server pipeline of US$54 billion. The core devices franchise still funds this, with Intelligent Devices Group revenue up 27% to US$17.1 billion and global PC share of 24.2%. Solutions and Services Group reached record revenue of US$2.9 billion, up 28%, at a record 24.2% operating margin.
